action_items.action: Complete USAG Athlete Registration Form in parent portal
Complete Medical Release & Emergency Contact Update in parent portal
Sign and submit Team Contract (practice attendance, meet commitments, code of conduct)
Complete Payment Authorization for meet fees (estimated $200-400/season)

calendar_items.title: SFG Intrasquad Meet (mandatory)
calendar_items.location: SFG Main Gym, 2500 Tanseo Street, San Francisco

telegram_summary: 🤸 ACTION REQUIRED: SF Gymnastics team forms due May 10 — USAG registration, medical release, team contract, and meet fee authorization. Also $350 annual team fee. Mandatory intrasquad meet May 17-18.
why_it_matters: Your 6th grader cannot participate in team practices or meets without completing these required forms and paying fees by the May 10 deadline.
